Subject: Renewal and onboarding refresh — procurement questionnaire attached

Hi Jordan,

We’re preparing for our annual renewal and want to confirm the procurement steps so we can onboard the renewed contract in our procurement portal. Our priorities: lock the term before Sep 1, add +30% seats for Q4, and ensure the vendor onboarding package is current (SOC2 evidence, vendor attestation, and updated W-9).

I attached our standard procurement-form.xlsx — please complete the vendor details and return so we can create the PO. Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports a 24-month term (instead of 12) at the new seat level and whether pricing tiers change after the first year?

Suggested attendees if we need a quick sync: you (sales), Marissa Cole (account exec), and someone from finance/legal.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Procurement Lead, Starlite Health
procurement@starlitehealth.com

- procurement-form.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 10 Aug 2029 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and onboarding refresh — procurement questionnaire attached

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the form. I downloaded the spreadsheet and will populate vendor details today. Quick summary / proposed plan: 

- Term request: Redwood can offer a pricing cadence for a 24-month term — I’ll include a simple side-by-side: 12m vs 24m pricing with the +30% seat uplift.
- Seat top-up: we can provision the additional seats on day 1 of the renewal with a prorated invoice for the remainder of Q3; recommended to split PO into two lines if your finance team prefers separate billing for committed capacity vs overage.
- Procurement portal: we’ll refresh our vendor onboarding package and submit the SOC2 attestation + updated W-9 to your portal. Can you confirm whether your portal requires a specific file naming convention or evidence form?

Next action items (proposal):
1) I’ll return the completed procurement-form.xlsx by EOD Monday (attached back).
2) Marissa will draft the commercial summary and new SOW showing seat counts and term options.
3) Laura — copying you to confirm finance/legal checks (PO split, invoicing cadence, and contract clause for term extension).

If useful, we can do a 30-minute call on Monday 8/12 to align on the PO structure and portal upload. Available 10:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Jordan — looping in finance/legal items from our side so we don’t hit last-minute blockers. A few things to note for Starlite’s procurement team: 

1) PO Structure: We usually accept a single PO with separate line items for (a) committed seats for the contracted term and (b) one-off top-ups. If Starlite prefers two POs, that’s manageable but may delay invoicing.

2) Term Change: Moving to 24 months is fine; commercial will provide a 2-year schedule with a modest discount on year 2. We’ll include language to allow a 90-day notice if you need to reduce committed capacity at renewal to avoid auto-billing for year 2.

3) Procurement Portal Uploads: Our standard evidence bundle for onboarding refresh contains: SOC2 report (redacted), vendor attestation form (completed), updated W-9, and a short integration checklist. I’ve attached starlite_requirements.pdf which lists exact filenames and preferred formats for your portal (single ZIP named STL_evidence_[PO#].zip).

4) Legal / SLAs: Laura — can you confirm if we need a PO threshold amendment in the SOW for the additional seats? If finance needs the invoice split, we’ll prepare a billing addendum.

Emily — I’ll prepare the commercial summary and a draft SOW today and target to send it by 3pm PT. If the portal requires DocuSign routing for the SOW, please include the DocuSign link when you create the PO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- starlite_requirements.pdf (PDF)
